source_refs.note: Topic 12.12.1, printed page 283. The print groups penicillins and cephalosporins with sulfonamides; the lesson keeps the examples and notes the ring sulfur.

blocks.text: Sulfa drugs, the antibacterial sulfonamides, contain sulfur, as do penicillins and cephalosporins. The common drug omeprazole, used for GERD (gastro-oesophageal reflux disease), contains a sulfoxide group.
